tasks.result:
## Outcome
Done: I read `inventory.ts` and answered Q3 from the code; nothing was edited.

## Findings
- Initial stock is `A1: 3`, `B2: 0`, `C3: 12` (`/tmp/v4orch/w/t1/src/inventory.ts:1`).
- `inStock` returns true when stock is greater than 0 (line 2). So A1 and C3 are in stock; B2 is not.
- `reserve` returns false when `have < qty`, otherwise sets stock to `have - qty` and returns true (lines 3–8).
- First `reserve('A1', 3)`: have 3, not less than 3, so stock becomes 0 and it returns `true`.
- Second `reserve('A1', 3)`: have 0 is less than 3, so it returns `false` and stock stays at 0.

## Verification
Read `/tmp/v4orch/w/t1/src/inventory.ts` in full (9 lines) and traced both calls by hand.
